root.name: Sodium Attack: Celadon Variation
root.moves: 1. Na3 e5 2. d3 Bxa3 3. bxa3 d5 4. e3 c5 5. Rb1

overview: After 1.Na3 e5 2.d3 Bxa3 3.bxa3 White accepts doubled a-pawns and an open b-file for the Rb1. Black gets the bishop for a knight, easy development and a central majority. White has an open b-file and the bishop pair, but pawns are poor. I judge from the moves.

white_ideas.idea: Use the open b-file with Rb1 and develop with e3

typical_structures.structure: White doubled a-pawns against a Black centre of d5, e5 and c5

character.reason: Slow play with doubled pawns for White.

soundness.reason: Looks bad for White but not losing.

structure.reason: Black holds a big centre; unsure.

approach.reason: 1.Na3 is hardly ever played by strong players.

plans.reason: White accepts doubled pawns for the b-file and bishop pair.
